transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um… mostly my sleep. It’s gotten pretty bad. I’ll be in bed for hours, laptop closed and everything, but my mind just keeps going over work deadlines, tuition stuff, class assignments… and even when I do sleep, I wake up feeling like I never really shut off.
When these worries start at night, do you feel like you can control them?

Not really. I try to tell myself to stop, or just focus on one thing, but it kind of branches off. Then I’m checking my calendar, my budget, assignments… over and over, instead of actually doing anything useful.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about many different parts of your life, not just sleep?

Yeah… it’s not just sleep. It jumps around a lot. Work, school money, assignments, my family… like, whether they’ll think I can’t handle things. Even small stuff starts feeling like it could mess up everything long-term.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
I don’t know… not really “depressed,” I guess. More just worn out and stressed. I haven’t really thought about it that way.
Have these worries been happening more days than not for at least six months?
Yeah… I think so. It’s been more days than not. Probably about a year and a few months now—since I started the evening certificate program while still working full-time.
Do you often feel restless or on edge?
I’m not sure… maybe sometimes. I guess I do feel kind of keyed up, but I don’t really know how to separate that from just being stressed.
Do you have trouble concentrating because of the worry?

Yeah… I do. I’ll be looking at a financial model or trying to read for class, and I realize I’ve gone over the same paragraph several times and still don’t know what it said. My mind’s already off thinking about what could go wrong.
Do you often feel tired during the day?
Yeah. By midafternoon at work I’m usually just… wiped out. Even small things, like answering emails or getting to the subway, feel like a lot. And weekends don’t really seem to reset it.
Have you been feeling more irritable than usual?
I don’t know… maybe a little? I haven’t really been tracking it. I try not to snap at people, but I’m not sure if it’s more than usual.
Do you often feel muscle tension?
I’m not really sure. I mean… I get tense sometimes, but I haven’t paid much attention to whether it’s a regular thing.
Have you ever had a period when you felt unusually energetic or high, more than your normal self?
I don’t think so… I mean, I have days where I get more done, but not really “high” or unusually energetic like that.
When you can’t fall asleep, is it usually because your mind is stuck on worries?
Yeah… mostly. I’ll be in bed for hours, laptop closed, and I’m still going over deadlines or tuition stuff or assignments in my head. Even when I do sleep, it doesn’t really feel like I shut off.
Are these worries interfering with your work or school performance?

Yeah… it’s starting to. I’ve missed some work deadlines, and I’m falling behind in my certificate classes. I’ve also kind of stopped doing the things that usually keep me on track, like yoga or running… even cooking.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient reports excessive, difficult-to-control worry across multiple life domains occurring more days than not for over a year, with associated concentration problems, fatigue, feeling keyed up, and significant sleep disturbance. The anxiety is causing functional impairment at work and school. Insomnia appears secondary to pervasive anxiety rather than a primary sleep disorder, and although symptoms began in the context of increased life demands, the chronic, generalized pattern is more consistent with generalized anxiety disorder than adjustment disorder.
